document:25:638:0.text:
Memory Stars record past scenes from the user's perspective, but not their inner thoughts.
Without the enchanting device, Memory Stars can still be created using the following method:
1. The mage performing the memory extraction, segmentation, or preservation spells must have graduated from the Serene Lyceum with an overall grade of "Excellent" and hold the endorsement of at least two faculty members.
2. The storage medium must be made from <style="highlight">highly stable magical materials</style> and thoroughly insulated to ensure it does not deteriorate for at least three hundred years.
3. Prepare <style="highlight">chronostatin</style> in advance to seal the Memory Fragments.
4. Multiple types of <style="highlight">arcane reagents</style> are required to aid the spellcasting process. Without them, enchanting the Memory Star will be extremely difficult.
5. While the spell is being cast, the memory's owner must maintain unwavering focus and resolve. Their emotional state must closely mirror that of the recorded memory to prevent emotional backlash.
6. Memory extraction must take place in a quiet, secure environment. When the spell is cast on another person, the spellcaster should be mentally prepared to experience the same emotions as the memory's owner.
7. A calming elixir must be consumed immediately after extraction to prevent lingering emotions and sensory confusion.
8. Each Memory Star can store only one scene. It must be imbued with magic before the memory can be viewed.
9. Memory Stars can be carved into any shape you like—just not bottles or jars!
document:25:638:0.source_cn:
记忆之星是回溯性质的景象，不能记录使用者视角之外的事情，也不能揭露使用者当时内心的旁白。
若无制作记忆之星的魔法仪器，只能采用基础的制作方式：
1.施展提取、切割、保存记忆法术的魔法师，需通过莱希拉姆魔法学院专业认证，有2名以上任教老师作为担保，课程均分为“优秀“；
2.存放记忆的媒介必须是<style="highlight">稳定性极高的魔法素材</style>，还需进行完善的绝缘处理，保证其三百年内都不会变质；
3.施法前，需准备封存记忆碎片的<style="highlight">时凝液</style>；
4.必须使用多种<style="highlight">魔导材料</style>来协助施法，否则几乎无法为记忆之星附魔；
5.施法时，记忆的主人必须集中精神，意志坚定，保证情绪不能和当时有过大差异，以防情感反噬；
6.提取记忆必须在安静且安全的环境中进行。若为他人施法，也会经受同等的情绪冲击，需做好心理准备；
7.提取完毕后需及时服用安神药剂，以避免情绪残留或是感官混淆；
8.一个记忆之星只能储存一段回忆，使用时需向其中注入魔力；
9.可将记忆之星进行切割与加工，做成使用者喜欢的样子。不要是瓶子、罐子！

say:13:1821326013:0.text: Because I can still perform onstage and connect with my audience, adjusting to life as a Graveborn hasn't been hard for me.

say:16:1821326016:1.text: Senea's taken to life in Novaris like a duck to water. That makes her a great role model for the children. Besides, they all love spending time with her!
say:16:1821326016:1.source_cn: 塞涅小姐确实比常人要豁达许多，这对孩子们来说也是好事。...

say:18:1821326017:1.text: Lilli, has everyone on your side received their gifts? I've got one extra.
say:18:1821326017:1.source_cn: 莉栗，你那边的孩子都拿到礼物了吗？我这多了一份。

say:19:1821326018:1.source_cn: 啊？不应该呀……我只挑出了塞勒斯和婕德的两份，是不是有...

say:1:1821332001:0.text: "I used to be a frail and sickly child. Every day, I walked that same path with my mother, mile by mile."
say:1:1821332001:0.source_cn: “儿时的我，体弱多病，每天跟随妈妈走过那条熟悉的路。”

say:2:1821332002:0.text: "We always went to her little apothecary. Its doors would open, then close once more, welcoming in the weary souls."
say:2:1821332002:0.source_cn: “路的尽头，是妈妈开设的药铺；店门开了又关，里面尽是愁...

say:3:1821332003:0.text: "Their tired eyes would light up with joy, smiling at me with all their might. I'd wave goodbye as they walked away, not knowing why some couldn't stay."

say:4:1821332004:0.source_cn: “妈妈啊，那个爷爷去哪了？那个爱笑的阿姨，怎么再也没来过？”

say:5:1821332005:0.text: "Mom drew me into her arms so warm, her gentle voice like shelter from the storm: 'Some farewells lead to sweeter encounters, waiting for us, just around the corner.'"

say:6:1821332006:0.text: "Maybe they've gone to a land so bright, where pain and sickness fade from sight. They're waiting for us on that distant shore, until the day we meet once more."

say:7:1821332007:0.text: "From then on, I feared goodbyes no more. Mom taught me that every ending holds something more."
say:7:1821332007:0.source_cn: “所以我学会了不再害怕再见，因为妈妈说过离别不是终点。”

say:8:1821332008:0.text: "That's something we'll all come to understand for sure..."
say:8:1821332008:0.source_cn: “总有一天，我们都会明白：有些别离，是为了更好的相聚……”

say:12:1821332011:1.text: As the song comes to an end, the children sit so captivated that not one of them stirs.
say:12:1821332011:1.source_cn: 一曲唱罢，孩子们沉浸在塞涅的歌声中，竟无人回神。

say:13:1821332012:1.text: S-Senea... has such a wonderful voice...

say:19:1821332017:1.text: And you can do the same. It's normal to fear death, as it means you still long to live. Now, you just need time to get used to a different way of existing.

say:21:1821332019:1.text: The day you graduate from here, I'll put on a show in your honor.
